patch_description:
The current ANSATZ_SPEC applies CZ gates only on ring edges (0,1), (2,3), (4,5), (6,7) but does not include any fixed entanglement gates connecting the center qubit to the hub. Meanwhile, parametrized CRX gates connect (1,8), (3,8), (5,8), (7,8).

By adding fixed CZ gates on (3,8) and (7,8), we fully connect the center qubit to all four cardinal hub edges with fixed (parameter-free) two-qubit gates. This enriches the entangling landscape and improves information flow through the center without increasing the parameter count.

The added depth is minimal (~2 gates per block, ~6 gates total over 3 uploads × 2 repeats), keeping the circuit in the efficient regime. This aligns with the system's recommendation to "fully connect the center qubit by appending CZ gates on (3, 8) and (7, 8)."
